admission.justification: Realized across dagger_authority.py, dagger_runner.py, sandbox.py, clean_executor.py, diagnostic_executor.py, final_codex_executor.py, gate.py, and clean_room.py, guarded by authority and executor tests, and prevents the pinned Dagger v0.21.8 CLI from silently ignoring DAGGER_HOST and connecting to an unadmitted engine.

applicability: Every shared Dagger runtime admission, Docker engine inspection, and child Dagger launch across clean-room, diagnostic, and final-Codex quality execution.
conditions: The declared endpoint must match container://<name-or-id> with [a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+ before any Docker probe; the written endpoint and engineId stay verbatim in the authority snapshot digest.

authority_environment binds _EXPERIMENTAL_DAGGER_RUNNER_HOST to snapshot.endpoint, omits DAGGER_HOST and overriding session/cloud selectors (DAGGER_CLOUD_ENGINE, DAGGER_SESSION_PORT, DAGGER_SESSION_TOKEN), and refuses conflicting ambient DAGGER_HOST or _EXPERIMENTAL_DAGGER_RUNNER_HOST values.
Sandbox manifests, clean-quality outcomes, strict quality reports, and clean_room CLI stderr name every present selector dropped from the child environment without exposing its value.
Inspection and child execution share native_dagger_environment so PATH, HOME, and DOCKER_CONFIG remain absolute across directory changes.
exclusions: Provisioning or starting a Dagger engine container, which remains refused.
Hand-written external environment files outside the declared authority.

evidence: Carried E12 re-exercised inside Light E9 on managed Python 3.14.10 plus live Heavy E5 Dagger proof PASS (selectorMatched: true on container://dagger-engine-v0.21.8, sameEngineBeforeAfter: true, engineCreateStartRecords: 0, containerCreateStartRecords: 0).

statement: The pinned Dagger CLI receives the exact admitted container name or ID and the run names dropped ambient selectors without reporting their values.
title: Dagger CLI receives exact admitted container ref and names dropped selectors
